about: Painted HUD icons (public/art/hud, 19) and point-of-interest icons (public/art/pois, 24): Higgsfield gpt_image_2_5, medium, transparent, text-to-image with the resource-icon sheet as style reference (same look as items/resources/research).

prompts.hud: Game HUD button icon: {subject}. Match the rendering style of the reference icons exactly (stylized 3D game icon, chunky shapes, soft warm lighting, bright saturated cozy colors, subtle rim light), but draw ONLY the new subject, none of the reference objects. Bold simple silhouette that reads clearly at very small size, front three-quarter view, centered, filling the frame, isolated on a transparent background. No text, no frame, no ground shadow.
prompts.pois: Game map location icon: {subject}. Match the rendering style of the reference icons exactly (stylized 3D game icon, chunky shapes, soft warm lighting, bright saturated cozy colors, subtle rim light), but draw ONLY the new subject, none of the reference objects. Compact diorama-style object, three-quarter view, centered, filling the frame, isolated on a transparent background. No text, no frame, no ground plane.

postprocess: remove border-connected background haze (flood fill below max border alpha + 24), trim to alpha bounds, pad square 4%, resize 128px LANCZOS, WebP q82
